reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.spend_date, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
), running AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT channel_id, spend_date,
    SUM(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_eur,
    SUM(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id) AS total_eur
  FROM daily
)
SELECT channel_id, MIN(spend_date) AS half_spend_date
FROM running
WHERE cumulative_eur >= 0.5 * total_eur
GROUP BY channel_id

WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.spend_date, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
)
SELECT d.channel_id, MIN(d.spend_date) AS half_spend_date
FROM daily d
WHERE (SELECT SUM(d2.spend_eur) FROM daily d2 WHERE d2.channel_id = d.channel_id AND d2.spend_date <= d.spend_date)
      >= 0.5 * (SELECT SUM(d3.spend_eur) FROM daily d3 WHERE d3.channel_id = d.channel_id)
GROUP BY d.channel_id
